wrong.why: The verse identifies Heber with the descendants of Hobab but does not mention Reuel or state descent from him.

missing.why: The Hebrew calls Hobab חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה, rendered in the KJV as the father-in-law of Moses.

note: The Hobab–Moses relationship stated here is retained as a variant alongside the brother-in-law relationship recorded from Numbers. Neither owner-recorded row appears wrong.
